Type: tufted upholstered bedroom bench
Use: seating at the foot of a bed, extra seating; bedroom, living room, entryway
Style: contemporary, industrial, modern
Materials: tufted fabric cushion, dark bronze metal frame
Colors: oatmeal beige, dark bronze brown
Shape: long rectangular padded seat, button tufting, open square-tube metal frame with six legs and low stretchers, backless, armless, long and light
Feel: calm, tailored, airy
Goes with: neutral bedding, dark wood, black or bronze accents; modern or industrial bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Metal Bedroom Bench with Cushion, 58"W, Oatmeal
product.description: A great accent piece, this modern upholstered bench will fit just right at the foot of your bed or in an entryway. With a plush ivory tufted cushion and oiled bronze metal legs, its open, airy design adds seating without making the room feel crowded. 58"L x 18"W x 19"H Metal and fabric (65% rayon; 35% linen) Simple, transitional design with neutral cushion and metal base Steel base provides sturdy support Assemble in 15-30 minutes; attach seat to base Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
